mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 2.5% and remains elevated for two consecutive months, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and a contraction in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a weakening consumer demand that triggers corporate revenue concerns, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails when both HOUST and RSAFS decline simultaneously in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 6.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE declines in a high-unemployment regime, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 for two consecutive months signals a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate profitability expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-housing-starts regime (HOUST < 900.0), a rebound in housing starts above 900.0 signals a recovery in the housing market that boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST rebounds above 900.0 in a low-housing-starts regime, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and a decline in the core inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) signals a 'soft landing' monetary policy that reduces recession risks and supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The positive return signal fails when FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL declines simultaneously in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.
